alert.note: Shadcn default destructive red. Confirmed as a token; not yet used anywhere in shipped product UI beyond form aria-invalid states.

confirmation-green.note: Tailwind emerald-950..emerald-100 stops (dark to light). #34d399 (emerald-400) is the dark-mode value the app actually uses in place of #10b981.

signal-sky.note: Chart-only series color, synthesized ramp in OKLCH. Never used in UI chrome.

signal-violet.note: Chart-only series color, synthesized ramp in OKLCH. Never used in UI chrome.

signal-amber.note: Also the Insight Note background tint (at 10% opacity) and text color (amber-700 / amber-400).

signal-rose.note: Chart-only negative/warning series and the low end of the Range Bar gradient.

headline.purpose: The single featured metric in a bento tile (ROCE, EPS, latest close) — the largest text on any screen.

body.purpose: Default text: table cells, tile values, paragraph copy.

label.purpose: Muted captions: tile labels, chart subtitles.

mono-label.purpose: Statement-table period/date headers and chart axis ticks — signals machine-sourced data (the Ledger Header Rule).

shadows.name: scroll-continuation-edge
shadows.purpose: Right edge of a sticky table column, signaling more content scrolls underneath. Dark mode: rgba(0,0,0,0.5).

shadows.name: active-tab
shadows.purpose: shadcn's default shadow-sm, applied to the selected tab in the default (non-line) tabs variant.

motion.name: tab-underline-spring
motion.purpose: The shared layoutId underline sliding between active tabs in the Company Analysis nav.

motion.name: sidebar-nav-spring
motion.purpose: Sidebar nav items sliding/fading in on load, staggered ~40ms apart.

motion.name: number-tick-ease
motion.purpose: AnimatedNumber/AnimatedRange ticking from the previous reading to the new one.

motion.name: panel-reveal-fade
motion.purpose: Tab panel content fade-in on tab switch — deliberately quiet, no spatial movement.

motion.name: refresh-sweep
motion.purpose: Emerald sweep bar under the tab list while a company switch is loading. Gated by prefers-reduced-motion at the CSS keyframe level.

motion.name: stagger-row-fade
motion.value: fade-in + slide-in-from-bottom(4px), 300ms, fill-mode-backwards, 40ms stagger per row
motion.purpose: Statement table and metric tile row/entrance animation.

motion.name: range-bar-draw-in
motion.purpose: The 52-week range bar's fill drawing in on mount.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Highest-emphasis action. Graphite fill, never the emerald accent.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.375rem; height: 2rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border-radius: 0.625rem; border: 1px solid transparent; background: oklch(0.205 0 0); color: oklch(0.985 0 0); font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.205 0 0), transparent 20%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px oklch(0.708 0 0 / 50%); border-color: oklch(0.708 0 0); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Chart Card
components.description: Signature wrapper for every trend/comparison chart — title, muted subtitle, optional single action (e.g. a two-state toggle).
components.html:
Net profit margin trend

Net profit ÷ revenue, by quarter

Chart renders here
components.css: .ds-chart-card { border-radius: 1.125rem; background: oklch(1 0 0); border: 1px solid oklch(0.922 0 0); padding: 1rem; } .ds-chart-card-head { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; margin-bottom: 0.75rem; } .ds-chart-card-title { font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-family: Geist, ui-sans-serif, system-ui; margin: 0; } .ds-chart-card-sub { font-size: 0.75rem; color: oklch(0.556 0 0); margin: 0; }

components.name: Metric Bento Featured Tile
components.description: The 2×2 emerald-tinted highlight tile inside a metric bento grid — carries the one headline-scale number on screen.
components.css: .ds-bento-featured { position: relative; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 1.125rem; padding: 1rem 1.25rem; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, #10b981, transparent 80%); background: color-mix(in oklch, #10b981, transparent 95%); } .ds-bento-featured-label { font-size: 0.75rem; font-weight: 500; color: #047857; } .ds-bento-featured-value { font-size: 1.5rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; color: oklch(0.145 0 0); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.name: Insight Note
components.description: Amber-tinted flag beneath a chart. Renders only when the data genuinely satisfies the condition it's reporting — never a static message.
components.html: DII holding overtook FII holding for the first time in this window in Jun 2025.
components.css: .ds-insight-note { margin-top: 0.75rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; background: color-mix(in oklch, #f59e0b, transparent 90%); color: #b45309; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.4; }

components.name: Range Bar
components.description: 52-week low→high price range. Gradient track, fill draws in on mount via scaleX.
components.css: .ds-range-bar { height: 0.5rem; width: 100%; overflow: hidden; border-radius: 9999px; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); } .ds-range-bar-fill { height: 100%; width: 100%; border-radius: 9999px; transform-origin: left; background: linear-gradient(to right, color-mix(in oklch, #f43f5e, transparent 70%), oklch(0.97 0 0), color-mix(in oklch, #10b981, transparent 60%)); }

components.name: Line Tab (active)
components.description: Main Company Analysis section nav. Active label turns Confirmation Green; the underline is a separate shared element that springs between tabs.
components.css: .ds-tabs-line { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.25rem; align-items: center; } .ds-tab { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border-radius: 0.5rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: color-mix(in oklch, oklch(0.145 0 0), transparent 40%); background: transparent; border: none; transition: color 0.15s; } .ds-tab:hover { color: oklch(0.145 0 0); } .ds-tab-active { color: #059669; } .ds-tab-underline { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0.375rem; bottom: -8px; height: 2px; border-radius: 9999px; background: #10b981; }

components.name: Secondary Badge
components.description: Small inline metadata chip, e.g. the "Recent trades" info badge on the Shareholding chart — paired with a tooltip for anything needing more explanation.
components.html: Recent trades
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.25rem; height: 1.25rem; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; border-radius: 1.625rem; background: oklch(0.97 0 0); color: oklch(0.205 0 0); font-size: 0.6875rem; font-weight: 500; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-badge-icon { width: 0.75rem; height: 0.75rem; flex-shrink: 0; }

narrative.overview:
Stockify's interface is deliberately quiet so that when it actually has something to say, it's unmistakable. The chrome is pure shadcn neutral — oklch grayscale, zero chroma, no brand color anywhere in the shell — and exactly one hue, emerald, is allowed to mean anything: "this is real, this is confirmed, look here." That single color does three jobs at once — the active tab, the live-refresh sweep, and the positive series in every chart — and never a fourth. Everything else (an amber-tinted insight note, a chart's muted qualitative palette) exists to flag something the underlying data actually proved true, never to decorate.

The voice is dense and technical, explicitly not a consumer fintech app: no rounded illustration blobs, no marketing whitespace, no gradient hero moments. It reads closer to a terminal or a ledger than an app — Geist Mono renders every statement-table period header as if it were stamped from a machine feed, while Geist Sans carries the numbers themselves so they stay comfortable to actually read. Depth is almost entirely absent: surfaces are separated by 1px hairline rings, not shadows, and the few real box-shadows that exist are working parts rather than atmosphere.
keyCharacteristics: One accent (emerald / Confirmation Green), used for confirmation and live state only — never decoration.
Monospace for machine-sourced labels (dates, periods), humanist sans for the numbers meant to be read.
Flat, ring-bordered surfaces; shadow is functional, never ambient.
A separate, muted five-color qualitative palette exists solely for chart series and never leaks into UI chrome.
Motion is restrained and purposeful: numbers tick instead of pop, panels fade instead of slide, and the one continuous animation (the refresh sweep) exists only while data is actually stale.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Emerald means "confirmed/live/positive" and nothing else, in chrome or in charts. If a new chart needs a "this is the good line" color, it's this green — never invent a second meaning for it, and never use it for something neutral just because it's the brand color.

rules.name: The Real Palette Rule
rules.body: globals.css still defines --chart-1 through --chart-5 as shadcn's default 0-chroma grayscale scaffolding — nothing in the product actually uses them. The real, chosen chart palette is the five exported hex constants (EMERALD/SKY/AMBER/ROSE/VIOLET) in company-charts.tsx. Don't reach for the CSS variables when adding a new chart.

rules.name: The Ledger Header Rule
rules.body: Any header that names a time period or filing date renders in Geist Mono. The data itself stays in Geist Sans with tabular-nums so it's comfortable to actually read.

rules.name: The Flat Ledger Rule
rules.body: Depth is earned, not decorative. Cards and containers are separated by a 1px hairline ring, not a shadow. Every real box-shadow in the system signals a specific interaction state or scroll affordance, never atmosphere.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Radius Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls sit tight (8-10px); containers sit loose (14-18px, badges fully pill at 26px). Never swap the two.

dos: Do keep emerald to exactly one meaning (confirmed/live/positive) across chrome and charts — the One Signal Rule.
Do render statement-table and chart-axis period/date labels in Geist Mono, and the numbers themselves in Geist Sans with tabular-nums — the Ledger Header Rule.
Do make an Insight Note's appearance conditional on a real, computed fact about the data on screen; never ship one that always renders.
Do use the opaque-background + edge-shadow pattern for any new sticky table column; a translucent sticky background will ghost.
Do keep new wide elements contained by their own card's horizontal scroll — never let one drag the sidebar or page sideways.
donts: Don't use the scaffolded --chart-1...--chart-5 CSS variables for a new chart — they're unused grayscale placeholders. Use the real EMERALD/SKY/AMBER/ROSE/VIOLET constants.
Don't add a decorative/ambient box-shadow anywhere — every shadow in this system does a specific job.
Don't give a button or badge a card-sized radius, or a card a button-sized radius.
Don't phrase an auto-generated insight as a recommendation or prediction — this content must read as observation, not advice.
Don't reach for a second accent color for "this also matters" — a second UI-chrome accent would break the One Signal Rule.
